paragraphs.text: 1. HE only is the Sea, holder of treasures: born many a time he views the hearts within us.
paragraphs.original: एकः समुद्रो धरुणो रयीणामस्मद्धृदो भूरिजन्मा वि चष्टे ।
paragraphs.translit: ekaḥ samudro dharuṇo rayīṇāmasmaddhṛdo bhūrijanmā vi caṣṭe |

paragraphs.text: He hides him in the secret couple's bosom. The Bird dwells in the middle of the fountain.
paragraphs.original: सिषक्त्यूधर्निण्योरुपस्थ उत्सस्य मध्ये निहितं पदं वेः
paragraphs.translit: siṣaktyūdharniṇyorupastha utsasya madhye nihitaṃ padaṃ veḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Inhabiting one dwelling-place in common, strong Stallions and the Mares have come together.
paragraphs.original: समानं नीळं वृषणो वसानाः सं जग्मिरे महिषा अर्वतीभिः ।
paragraphs.translit: samānaṃ nīḷaṃ vṛṣaṇo vasānāḥ saṃ jagmire mahiṣā arvatībhiḥ |

paragraphs.text: The sages guard the seat of Holy Order, and keep the highest names concealed within them.
paragraphs.original: ऋतस्य पदं कवयो नि पान्ति गुहा नामानि दधिरे पराणि
paragraphs.translit: ṛtasya padaṃ kavayo ni pānti guhā nāmāni dadhire parāṇi

paragraphs.text: 3. The Holy Pair, of wondrous power, have coupled: they formed the Infant, they who bred produced him.
paragraphs.original: ऋतायिनी मायिनी सं दधाते मित्वा शिशुं जज्ञतुर्वर्धयन्ती ।
paragraphs.translit: ṛtāyinī māyinī saṃ dadhāte mitvā śiśuṃ jajñaturvardhayantī |

paragraphs.text: The central point of all that moves and moves not, the while they wove the Sage's thread with insight
paragraphs.original: विश्वस्य नाभिं चरतो ध्रुवस्य कवेश्चित्तन्तुं मनसा वियन्तः
paragraphs.translit: viśvasya nābhiṃ carato dhruvasya kaveścittantuṃ manasā viyantaḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. For tracks of Order and refreshing viands attend from ancient times the goodly Infant.
paragraphs.original: ऋतस्य हि वर्तनयः सुजातमिषो वाजाय प्रदिवः सचन्ते ।
paragraphs.translit: ṛtasya hi vartanayaḥ sujātamiṣo vājāya pradivaḥ sacante |

paragraphs.text: Wearing him as a mantle, Earth and Heaven grow strong by food of pleasant drink and fatness.
5. He, calling loudly to the Seven red Sisters, hath, skilled in sweet drink, brought them to be looked on.
paragraphs.original: सप्त स्वसॄररुषीर्वावशानो विद्वान्मध्व उज्जभारा दृशे कम् ।
paragraphs.translit: sapta svasṝraruṣīrvāvaśāno vidvānmadhva ujjabhārā dṛśe kam |

paragraphs.text: He, born of old, in middle air hath halted, and sought and found the covering robe of Pusan.
6. Seven are the pathways which the wise have fashioned; to one of these may come the troubled mortal.
He standeth in the dwelling of the Highest, a Pillar, on sure ground where paths are parted.
paragraphs.original: आयोर्ह स्कम्भ उपमस्य नीळे पथां विसर्गे धरुणेषु तस्थौ
paragraphs.translit: āyorha skambha upamasya nīḷe pathāṃ visarge dharuṇeṣu tasthau

paragraphs.text: 7. Not Being, Being in the highest heaven, in Aditi's bosom and in Daksa's birthplace,
Is Agni, our first-born of Holy Order, the Milch-cow and the Bull in life's beginning.
paragraphs.original: अग्निर्ह नः प्रथमजा ऋतस्य पूर्व आयुनि वृषभश्च धेनुः
paragraphs.translit: agnirha naḥ prathamajā ṛtasya pūrva āyuni vṛṣabhaśca dhenuḥ
